mapper.select: SELECT wh.id, wh.workflow_version_id AS workflowVersionId, u.real_name AS operatorName, wh.action, wh.change_summary AS changeSummary, wh.change_log AS changeLog, wh.version_snapshot AS versionSnapshot, wh.created_at AS createdAt FROM workflow_history wh LEFT JOIN users u ON wh.operator_id = u.id WHERE wh.workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId} ORDER BY wh.created_at DESC

SELECT wh.id, wh.workflow_version_id AS workflowVersionId, u.real_name AS operatorName, wh.action, wh.change_summary AS changeSummary, wh.created_at AS createdAt FROM workflow_history wh LEFT JOIN users u ON wh.operator_id = u.id WHERE wh.workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId} AND wh.action IN ('publish', 'activate') ORDER BY wh.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
